silly.en: Don't be silly...! Coming somewhere else to try and face my fears... maybe do a bit of shopping.
silly.zh: 别开玩笑了……！换个地方继续直面我的恐惧……顺便逛逛街。

silly.en: Can I? Can I get behind the wheel? Don't be silly!
silly.zh: 可以吗？我能去坐驾驶位吗？别闹了！

silly.en: Yes, many. Once I met my parents in a car park and I saw them arriving in their car and I waved my hands around in a very silly way.
silly.zh: 有啊，很多次。有一次我在停车场接我父母，我看到他们的车开过来，就用一种很滑稽的方式挥舞着双臂。

silly.en: I remember answering the phone, I thought it was my best friend and I said "hello" in a very silly voice, and then they asked to speak to my dad, and it wasn't my friend.
silly.zh: 我记得有一次接电话，我以为是我最好的朋友，就用一种很滑稽的语气说了一声“哈喽”，结果对方要求跟我爸爸讲话，那根本不是我朋友。

situation.en: A less confident speaker might freeze or stop speaking when in the same situation.
situation.zh: 而不太自信的说话者在遇到同样情况时，可能会僵住或停止说话。

situation.en: And finally, coping strategies are psychological ways of managing your emotions in challenging situations.
situation.zh: 最后，应对策略是在具有挑战性的情况下管理情绪的心理方式。

situation.en: Fergal mentions that he was hyper-vigilant because was in dangerous situations as a child.
situation.zh: 费尔加提到他高度警惕，因为他小时候处于危险的境地。

situation.en: The expression silver lining means a positive thing that comes from a negative situation.
situation.zh: silver lining 这个说法，指的是从一个不好的情况中产生出的积极结果。

situation.en: I find that stressful, too. And how do you cope with stressful situations, Neil?
situation.zh: 我也觉得那很有压力。尼尔，那你如何应对有压力的状况呢？

sign.en: At that moment, people often react with surprise, even though the signs were there.
sign.zh: 在那一刻，人们往往会惊慌失措，尽管迹象其实一直都在。

sign.en: The delegates who signed this document were effectively committing treason against the British Crown.
sign.zh: 签署这份文件的代表实际上是在犯下针对英国王室的叛国罪。

sign.en: This was a sign that Mexico City was considered a modern and successful city.
sign.zh: 这标志着墨西哥城被视为一座现代且成功的城市。

sign.en: Language is the most obvious, the most visible, the most measurable sign of this.
sign.zh: 语言是最明显、最直观、最可衡量的标志。

sign.en: Poverty is a sign that your country, your society, has economic and social problems.
sign.zh: 贫困表明你的国家、你的社会存在经济和社会问题。

signal.en: Simple nonverbal signals matter. Eye contact, nodding, and small reactions show that you are engaged.
signal.zh: 简单的非语言信号也很重要。眼神接触、点头以及细微的反应都表明你很投入。

signal.en: For example, a green man walking to signal it's safe to cross.
signal.zh: 例如，一个绿色的步行小人来发出可以安全过马路的信号。

signal.en: Here, for example, the brain works harder to compensate for a weaker sound signal reaching the inner ear.
signal.zh: 例如，在这里，大脑会更加努力地工作，以弥补到达内耳的较弱声音信号。

signal.en: We love understatement as a way of, kind of, signalling that something much more serious has gone on.
signal.zh: 我们喜欢用轻描淡写来暗示发生了更严重的事情。

signal.en: This was a clear signal that he intended to rule the entire island, not just manage it from afar.
signal.zh: 这是一个明确的信号，表明他打算统治整个岛屿，而不仅仅是远距离管理。

sink.en: I've enough stuff to tell you, I say, Sinking into a chair.
sink.zh: 我有足够的事情要告诉你，我说道，陷入一把椅子里。

sink.en: Unlike Earth, where heavy metals have sunk to the core, asteroids haven’t undergone the same processes of differentiation.
sink.zh: 与地球上重金属已经下沉到地核的情况不同，小行星没有经历过同样的熔融分异过程。

sink.en: However, in the small town of Schenectady, New York, one man read the manifesto and a terrible, sinking feeling came over him.
sink.zh: 然而，在纽约斯克内克塔迪小镇，一个人读了这份宣言，一种可怕、沉重的感觉涌上心头。

sink.en: When the solar system began to take shape, gravity caused much of the heavy material to sink towards the cores of the newly forming planets.
sink.zh: 当太阳系开始成形时，引力导致大部分重物质下沉到新形成行星的核心。

sink.en: By this point in time, there were hundreds of known shipwrecks with valuable treasure, from ancient Roman shipwrecks through to ships that had only sunk the previous year.
sink.zh: 到这个时候，有数百艘已知的沉船携带着宝贵的财富，从古罗马沉船到刚刚在前一年沉没的船只。

significant.en: They created a calendar system and they made significant advances in astronomy and mathematics.
significant.zh: 他们创建了历法系统，并在天文学和数学方面取得了重大进展。

significant.en: At the same time, there are significant opportunities for the EU to strengthen itself.
significant.zh: 与此同时，欧盟也迎来了巩固自身的重要机遇。

significant.en: Another significant challenge is that asteroids typically rotate, often unpredictably and at varying speeds.
significant.zh: 另一个重大挑战是小行星通常会旋转，而且往往是毫无规律地以不同的速度旋转。

significant.en: Most people in Overseas France consider themselves French, but there are significant independence movements.
significant.zh: 外海法国的大多数人认为自己是法国人，但也有重大的独立运动。

significant.en: It remains one of the most historically significant cities in the modern world.​
significant.zh: 它仍然是现代世界中最具历史意义的城市之一。

signify.en: If you say something is like an exclamation mark, you mean it signifies strong emotion, surprise or excitement, just like an exclamation mark does in writing.
signify.zh: 如果你说某物 like an exclamation mark（像一个感叹号），你的意思是它象征着强烈的情感、惊讶或兴奋，就像书写中的感叹号一样。

signature.en: A signature item is something that a person or place is known for.
signature.zh: A signature item 是指某人或某地因其而闻名的事物。

signature.en: For example, whisky is Scotland's signature drink.
signature.zh: 例如，威士忌是苏格兰的招牌饮料。

silver.en: And lots of wealth came into the city. There was silver from Mexican mines.
silver.zh: 大量的财富涌入这座城市。有来自墨西哥矿山的白银。

silver.en: The expression silver lining means a positive thing that comes from a negative situation.
silver.zh: silver lining 这个说法，指的是从一个不好的情况中产生出的积极结果。

silver.en: And finally, a silver bullet means a simple solution to a complicated problem.
silver.zh: 最后，silver bullet 指的是解决复杂问题的简单方案。

silver.en: This was 1977. The year of the Sex Pistols and the Queen's Silver Jubilee.
silver.zh: 那是 1977 年。性手枪乐队成立以及女王登基银禧庆典的年份。

silver.en: Paul says political scientists think the silver bullet is to get offline and meet people.
silver.zh: Paul 说，政治学家认为 silver bullet（灵丹妙药）就是离开网络去见人。

sickness.en: At first, it might have seemed like a sickness.
sickness.zh: 起初，这可能看起来像是一场病。

sickness.en: She has no doubt. And that's important, as the consequences of eating poisonous plants are serious – sickness or even death.
sickness.zh: 她毫无疑问。这很重要，因为食用有毒植物的后果很严重——生病甚至死亡。

sickness.en: So, which is it? Maybe a bit of all three: some sickness, a lot of fear, and plenty of human messiness.
sickness.zh: 所以，到底是因为什么？也许上述三者兼而有之：一些疾病，满腔恐惧，再加上一堆剪不断理还乱的人性纷争。

similarity.en: The phrase separated at birth can be used to describe two people with strong similarities.
similarity.zh: 短语“出生时分离”可以用来描述两个有强烈相似之处的人。

similarity.en: And this genetic similarity gives them an innate talent for sprinting.
similarity.zh: 正是这种基因相似性赋予了他们短跑的先天天赋。

similarity.en: It provided a unifying explanation for many scientific mysteries like fossils, biodiversity, and the similarities among species.
similarity.zh: 它为化石、生物多样性以及物种间的相似性等许多科学谜题提供了一种统一的解释。

similarity.en: The details are always different. But when we look at patterns over time, the similarities are hard to ignore.
similarity.zh: 细节总是不同的。但当我们审视跨时间的模式时，相似之处很难让人忽视。

similarity.en: On their own, these similarities are not evidence.
similarity.zh: 单看这些相似之处并不能构成证据。

sight.en: At medical school in Edinburgh, he quickly discovered that he hated the sight of surgery.
sight.zh: 在爱丁堡的医学院里，他很快发现自己极其讨厌看到手术的血腥场面。

sight.en: Open dormitories. Shared dining halls with long, visible sight lines.
sight.zh: 开放式宿舍。共享的餐厅，视线长且一览无余。

sight.en: In other words, he had his sights on Behan’s job.
sight.zh: 换句话说，他盯上的正是 Behan 的位子。

sight.en: The Royal Geographical Society had its sights set on South America and proposed this as an option to Fawcett.
sight.zh: 皇家地理学会将目光投向了南美洲，并向 Fawcett 提出了这个选项。

sight.en: The idiom love at first sight means being in love with someone as soon as you see them for the first time.
sight.zh: 习语“一见钟情”的意思是第一眼看到某人就爱上了他们。

silence.en: Rival princes who had not been caught up in the Ritz-Carlton purge suddenly found themselves silenced.
silence.zh: 那些没有在丽思卡尔顿大清洗中落网的敌对亲王们突然发现自己被噤声了。

silence.en: If you suffer in silence, you endure and struggle with painful feelings without asking someone for help.
silence.zh: 如果你 suffer in silence（默默承受痛苦），你就是在忍受和挣扎于痛苦的情绪中，却不向任何人寻求帮助。

silence.en: But silence often creates a worse impression than imperfect English.
silence.zh: 但沉默往往比不完美的英语给人留下更糟糕的印象。

silence.en: No car. No neighbours. Just trees, mountains, and silence.
silence.zh: 没有汽车。没有邻居。只有树木、高山和寂静。

silence.en: And so I then feel that we see a lot of people kind of suffering in silence really.
silence.zh: 因此，我觉得我们看到很多人其实都在默默承受着痛苦。

site.en: The distinction between UNESCO heritage sites and the New Seven Wonders is important.
site.zh: UNESCO遗产地与新世界七大奇迹之间的区别很重要。

site.en: More than 100 famous monuments and historical sites were nominated from around the world.
site.zh: 来自世界各地的100多个著名古迹和历史遗址被提名。

site.en: The website was structured in a very similar way to a site like eBay or Amazon.
site.zh: 该网站的结构与 eBay 或亚马逊等网站非常相似。

site.en: Under Nazi occupation, Warsaw became the site of some of the worst atrocities of the war.
site.zh: 在纳粹占领下，华沙成为了这场战争中最惨绝人寰的暴行发生地之一。

site.en: In 2012, UNESCO recognized parts of Rio’s landscape as a World Heritage Site.
site.zh: 2012年，联合国教科文组织将里约的部分景观认定为世界遗产。

singer.en: In 1896, a music hall singer had fallen on particularly hard times, and with nobody to turn to and no way to support her sons, she made the agonising decision to send them to a workhouse.
singer.zh: 1896 年，一位音乐厅歌手遭遇了特别艰难的时期，在走投无路且无法养活儿子的情况下，她做出痛苦的决定，将他们送进了济贫院。

sixty.en: Before 1641, Catholics had owned roughly sixty percent of the land in Ireland.
sixty.zh: 1641 年之前，天主教徒拥有爱尔兰约 60% 的土地。

sixty.en: He boards a plane for South Africa. He is sixty years old.
sixty.zh: 他登上了飞往南非的飞机。那年他六十岁。

sixty.en: The United Arab Emirates has announced that it is leaving OPEC (the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries) after almost sixty years as a member.
sixty.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国宣布，在加入石油输出国组织（OPEC）近六十年后，将退出该组织。

sin.en: And that made blasphemy not just a sin, but something closer to rebellion.
sin.zh: 这使得亵渎神明不仅是一种罪过，更接近于叛乱。

sin.en: It is imperfect, but to quote the two-time British Prime Minister, Winston Churchill, “Many forms of Government have been tried, and will be tried in this world of sin and woe.
sin.zh: 它并不完美，但正如两任英国首相温斯顿·邱吉尔所说：“在这个充满罪恶和悲伤的世界里，人们已经尝试过并且将继续尝试各种形式的政府。

silicon.en: And in this situation, tech bros, young men working in the tech industry, often in Silicon Valley.
silicon.zh: 在这种情况下，则是科技兄弟（tech bros），也就是在科技行业工作、通常在硅谷的年轻男性。

silicon.en: And many people are worried that Silicon Valley’s Bros might now be running more than just their companies.
silicon.zh: 许多人担心硅谷的兄弟们现在管理的不止是他们的公司了。

silicon.en: And can a man whose career was funded by one of Silicon Valley's wealthiest investors really be the champion of forgotten America?
silicon.zh: 一个职业生涯由硅谷最富有的投资者资助的人，真的能成为被遗忘的美国的斗士吗？

silicon.en: When I think of the USA, I picture New York’s skyscrapers, Hollywood movies, and Silicon Valley technology companies.
silicon.zh: 当我想到美国时，我的脑海中会浮现出纽约的摩天大楼、好莱坞电影以及硅谷的技术公司。

silicon.en: In September 2023, when multiple candidates were still vying for the Republican nomination, a fundraising dinner was held at a former Facebook executive’s Silicon Valley mansion.
silicon.zh: 2023 年 9 月，当多位候选人仍在争夺共和党提名时，在前 Facebook 高管的硅谷豪宅举行了一场筹款晚宴。

simplify.en: So nostalgia simplifies history. The 1950s and’60s in the US were not perfect.
simplify.zh: 因此，怀旧情绪将历史简单化了。美国20世纪50和60年代并非完美无瑕。

simplify.en: And, ta-da, that is a very simplified version of how nuclear energy works.
simplify.zh: 然后，当当，这就是核能工作原理的一个极其简化的版本。

simplify.en: You could even ask it to simplify something into B1-level English.
simplify.zh: 你甚至可以要求它把内容简化为 B1 级别的英语。

simplify.en: And here’s the danger. If you spend too much time listening to simplified AI-generated English, your brain will adapt to simplified English.
simplify.zh: 危险就在这里。如果你花太多时间听简化后的人工智能生成英语，你的大脑就会适应这种简化的英语。

simplify.en: Mustafa Kemal wanted literacy rates to rise, and he believed that by simplifying the language, more people would be able to read and write.
simplify.zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔希望提高识字率，他相信通过简化语言，更多的人将能够识字。

singular.en: Grammatically it's odd. It's 'safe as houses' [plural] even though you're describing something singular.
singular.zh: 它的语法很奇怪。虽然你描述的是单数事物，但它用的却是复数形式的 'safe as houses'。

significance.en: People read those books because of their importance, because of their religious or political significance.
significance.zh: 人们阅读这些书是因为它们的重要性，是因为它们具有宗教或政治意义。

significance.en: And today, the Great Wall still has a lot of cultural significance in China itself.
significance.zh: 而今天，长城在中国本土仍然具有很高的文化意义。

significance.en: Around the world, the fall of the Berlin Wall was seen as a moment of historic significance.
significance.zh: 在世界各地，柏林墙的倒塌被视为具有历史意义的时刻。

significance.en: To me, the significance of 1776 and the Declaration of Independence is not necessarily that thirteen colonies broke away from Britain.
significance.zh: 对我而言，1776年和《独立宣言》的意义不一定在于十三块殖民地脱离了英国。

significance.en: They’re not the same thing. UNESCO selects its heritage sites based on the historical and cultural significance of the site, while the New Seven Wonders were chosen through public voting and media campaigns.
significance.zh: 它们不是一回事。UNESCO根据遗址的历史和文化重要性来选择其遗产地，而新世界七大奇迹则是通过公众投票和媒体活动选出的。

simplicity.en: In the interests of simplicity, I’ll call them all DOGE going forward.
simplicity.zh: 为了简单起见，我接下来统称它们为 DOGE。

siege.en: The siege of Leningrad was one of the most brutal events of World War Two.
siege.zh: 列宁格勒围城战是第二次世界大战中最残酷的事件之一。

siege.en: Why not? Again, we can only speculate. Perhaps he lacked siege equipment.
siege.zh: 为什么不呢？我们依然只能推测。也许是因为缺乏攻城装备。

siege.en: Instead, the condottieri would rely on sieges, ambushes, and psychological tactics to wear down their opponents.
siege.zh: 相反，condottieri 会依靠围城、伏击和心理战术来消耗对手。

siege.en: The siege of Constantinople lasted over 50 days and was brutal.
siege.zh: 对君士坦丁堡的围困持续了50多天，极其残酷。

siege.en: He saw sieges, skirmishes, the management of supplies and morale.
siege.zh: 他目睹了围城战、小规模冲突以及补给和士气的管理。

similarly.en: Whistleblowers are similarly important. A whistleblower is a person who reports illegal or unethical behavior.
similarly.zh: 吹哨人同样重要。吹哨人是指举报非法或不道德行为的人。

similarly.en: Leap years would include one more extra day, often called a “leap day,” similarly placed outside the calendar structure.
similarly.zh: 闰年将包括另一个额外的一天，通常被称为“闰日”，同样放置在日历结构之外。

similarly.en: Similarly, “spill the beans” doesn’t involve beans at all.
similarly.zh: 同样，“spill the beans”和豆子一点关系也没有。

similarly.en: The Quran, similarly, has been spread around the world and is considered the second-most distributed book in history, with also over a billion published.
similarly.zh: 同样，《古兰经》也在世界各地流传，被认为是历史上发行量第二大的书，发行量也超过了十亿册。

similarly.en: Similarly, the giant tortoises on each island had different shell shapes, and locals could often identify a tortoise’s island simply by looking at its shell.
similarly.zh: 同样，每个岛上的巨龟都有不同的外壳形状，当地人通常只需看一眼龟壳就能认出乌龟来自哪个岛。

simulate.en: Another forced them to simulate sexual acts as a way of degrading them.
simulate.zh: 还有人逼他们模拟性行为，以此来羞辱他们。

silent.en: Leading questions limit honest answers. They push people to agree with you or they push people to stay silent, instead of expressing what they really think.
silent.zh: 引导性问题会限制坦诚的答案。它们会促使人们同意你的观点，或者促使人们保持沉默，而不是表达他们真正的想法。

silent.en: Online, in meetings or in online classes or online calls with your friends, it’s easy to stay silent or get ignored, so a clear and thoughtful question can really help you understand better and get people to understand you better.
silent.zh: 在线上，无论是开会、上在线课程还是与朋友进行网络通话，保持沉默或被忽视都很容易，因此一个清晰、周到的问题真的能大有帮助，让你更好地理解他人，也让别人更好地理解你。
